title: VOL 1&2 - THE CYCLOPEDIA OF TASMANIA & 1 OTHER
findings: Spines read: 'The Cyclopedia of Tasmania Vol. I' and 'Vol. II' in matching half leather with gilt-ruled spines and fleurons, blue textured cloth boards with leather corners; this two-volume format is the original 1900 edition (Maitland & Krone, Hobart), title pages not shown so publisher/date not confirmed from photos. The 'other' is a single red cloth volume, 'The Cyclopedia of Tasmania' blind/gilt on front board and spine, consistent with the 1931 one-volume edition (title page not shown). The 1900 two-volume set is a key Tasmanian biographical and illustrated reference and sells into the hundreds; the 1931 volume adds modest value.
condition: Half leather spines heavily rubbed and scuffed, joints and spine ends worn, vol. II leather darkened and flaking; cloth boards rubbed with a pale mark on vol. II; red volume faded with frayed spine ends. Internals unseen.
reason: Cyclopedia of Tasmania 2-vol set (1900 format) plus 1931 single volume, significant Tasmaniana.
